overview_description.description: Citra Style is a fashion and e-commerce company that focuses on modest fashion clothing and accessories for Muslim women. The company designs, produces, and sells apparel including hijabs, abayas, dresses, tunics, skirts, jackets, and modest wear collections through its online retail platform. Its products combine contemporary fashion styles with modest clothing requirements targeted at customers in the Middle East and international markets.
